Hey Alex,

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. We want to make sure the upcoming product walkthrough works for your team without making anyone join at an unfortunate hour. Because your stakeholders are on Eastern and our deep-dive engineers will be in Central Europe, there are two practical ways to do this:

- Standard overlap: 8:00 AM ET / 14:00 CEST — live demo with our EMEA engineering pair.
- Nightcap bridge: 11:00 PM ET / 05:00 CEST (+1) — short focused session where the US team runs the intro and our EMEA engineer stays on for the critical technical handover.

Quick Qs: can you confirm which of these two general windows is feasible for the main group? If neither works, tell me the earliest and latest times folks can tolerate on your side and we’ll propose a rotating host plan.

I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan for the PoC so we can lock owners once we pick a slot.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (PDF, 234 KB)

Suggested next step: pick one window and I’ll send a calendar invite for a 45-minute demo + 15-minute Q&A.

Best,
